title: fix: pin the sandbox template's versions so a rebuild picks up bumps
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Pinned versions in the E2B sandbox template so a version bump changes the build step and a rebuild installs the new release instead of reusing a cached npm step. The template specifies Node 24.21.0, polli 0.1.42, Claude Code 2.1.296, OpenCode 1.19.0, Pi 1.1.0, OpenClaw 2026.10.2, and Hermes v0.21.7, with both the Hermes installer and checkout pinned to commit 71d34bad. The stock e2b CLI built a temporary pollinations-test template in 3m32s; a box reported the pinned versions. The test template was deleted afterward. The base image and apt packages remain unpinned and refresh only when their build steps change.
